description: This script automates the creation of reference ABI dumps for Android products, involving directory management, library building, and dump copying, primarily used in Android build and testing processes.

classes.name: GetRefDumpDirStem
classes.description: Generates directory paths for reference dumps based on a base directory and architecture.

classes.name: GetVersionedRefDumpDirStem
classes.description: Generates versioned directory paths for reference dumps based on VNDK and platform versions, and binder bitness.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes directory stem objects with necessary versioning and path info.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Returns constructed directory path based on subdir and architecture.

methods.name: make_libs_for_product
methods.description: Builds libraries or directory trees for a given product and variant.

methods.name: tag_to_dir_name
methods.description: Converts a tag to its corresponding directory name.

methods.name: find_and_copy_lib_lsdumps
methods.description: Finds library dumps and copies them to reference directories.

methods.name: create_source_abi_reference_dumps
methods.description: Creates reference ABI dumps for specified targets.

methods.name: create_source_abi_reference_dumps_for_all_products
methods.description: Creates reference ABI dumps for all specified products.

methods.name: _parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates the creation of reference ABI dumps.
